references.text: At Mount Sinai the people were also told to keep their distance and not approach the holy place, just as here they must keep their distance from the ark of the covenant.
Moses asked to know God's ways, reflecting the theme of knowing the path one should walk.
The Lord went before the people to show them the way, just as the ark of the covenant was to go before them here to show the way.
A prayer that the Lord would teach His ways and guide on His paths, corresponding to the theme of knowing the path one should walk.
The call to trust in the Lord and not in one's own understanding, for He will make the paths straight, connects to the theme of following God's guidance on an unknown journey.
The Lord promises to lead the blind along a way they do not know, reflecting that Israel had never traveled this path before.
The call to stand on the ancient paths and ask for the good way relates to the theme of finding the right path.
Jesus says that He is the way, the truth, and the life, fulfilling the theme that God shows the way for His people.
